issues.summary: The notices file reproduced ANTLR's BSD-3-Clause text but only NAMED the MIT components (System.Data.OleDb, JsonSchema.Net) without their notices — incomplete for a tool package that redistributes those assemblies.
issues.fix: Inspect the produced .nupkg and add the full MIT copyright + license notices for every redistributed MIT-licensed assembly, or prove they are not redistributed.
issues.resolution_note: Evidence-checked the packed .nupkg: a dotnet tool declares NO <dependencies> and bundles its dependency DLLs under tools/<tfm>/ — confirmed Antlr4.Runtime.Standard, JsonSchema.Net, Json.More, JsonPointer.Net, Humanizer, System.Data.OleDb, System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager, System.Diagnostics.EventLog(+.Messages), System.Diagnostics.PerformanceCounter, System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData are all redistributed. Rewrote THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt to include the full MIT License text + the copyright holders (.NET Foundation and Contributors; Greg Dennis / json-everything) alongside the ANTLR BSD-3-Clause block. Updated the csproj + nuget-publish.md comments to match. Repack confirmed the corrected notices ship at the package root.

round_2.note: R1 Major confirmed FIXED. The only R2 finding is Minor — under the Set-071 materiality discipline a Minor-only round is effectively VERIFIED for the loop (no further remediation round required). The Minor was nonetheless fixed (cheap + valid), so no blocking findings remain.

issues.summary: The shipped notice file says "see LICENSE", but LICENSE was not packed into the .nupkg, so the reference was dead inside the distributed artifact.
issues.fix: Pack LICENSE at the package root (as a plain content file, keeping the MIT SPDX expression) or reword the reference.
issues.resolution_note: Added <None Include="..\LICENSE" Pack="true" PackagePath="\" /> to the CLI csproj; repack confirmed LICENSE (1067 bytes) now ships at the package root alongside THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt + nuget-readme.md, and the nuspec <license type="expression">MIT</license> is unchanged (plain content file, not <PackageLicenseFile>, so no conflict).
